Abstract. This FAQ answers the most common questions about Nexora products. Questions are grouped into general,
plans and billing, features and AI, integrations and API, security and data, and troubleshooting. Where a topic needs more
detail, the FAQ points to the Product Documentation (NX-PRD-001) or the API Documentation (NX-ENG-001).
Keywords: FAQ, billing, free trial, password reset, SSO, data export, API limits, troubleshooting
1. General
Q. What products does Nexora offer?
Nexora offers NexaDesk (AI-powered helpdesk), NexaFlow (workflow automation) and NexaInsight (analytics).
They share one login and one platform.
Q. Where is Nexora based and what are your support hours?
Nexora is headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan, with offices in Karachi and Islamabad. Support is available
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM PKT for Starter and Growth plans, and 24x7 for Enterprise. Contact
support@nexora.example.
Q. Which languages are supported?
The user interface is available in English. NexaDesk AI triage, suggestions and summaries support English and
Urdu; Arabic is in beta.

Q. Is there a free trial?
Yes. Every new workspace gets a 14-day free trial with Growth features. No credit card is needed to start.
Q. What is the discount for annual billing?
Annual billing is approximately 20% cheaper than monthly billing. Annual plans are invoiced once a year in
advance.
Q. What payment methods do you accept?
Credit and debit cards for all plans. Enterprise customers can pay by bank transfer against an invoice (net 30
days), in USD or PKR.

Q. Can I cancel at any time and get a refund?
You can cancel at any time from Settings, then Billing. Monthly plans stop at the end of the billing month.
Refunds are available within 14 days of the first paid charge; after that, annual plans are not refunded pro rata.
Q. What happens to my data after cancellation?
You can export your data for 30 days after cancellation. After 90 days all workspace data is permanently
deleted, and backups expire within 35 days after that.
3. Features and AI
Q. How does NexaDesk suggest answers?
NexaDesk searches your knowledge base using retrieval (RAG) and drafts a reply grounded in the top matching
articles. Each suggestion shows its source articles so the agent can check it before sending. Suggestions are
never sent automatically unless you enable auto-reply for selected topics.
Q. Does Nexora train AI models on my data?
No. Customer data is not used to train shared models, and model providers process prompts under
zero-retention terms.
Q. What file types can I add to the knowledge base?
HTML, Markdown, PDF and DOCX, up to 100,000 characters per article. Attachments on tickets can be up to 25
MB per file.
Q. How many workflows can I run?
Starter allows 5 active workflows, Growth 50, and Enterprise unlimited.
4. Integrations and API
Q. Which tools does Nexora integrate with?
Email, web chat, WhatsApp Business, Microsoft Teams and Slack channels, and Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira and
Zapier for business tools. Custom integrations use the REST API and webhooks.
Q. What are the API rate limits?
60 requests per minute on Starter, 300 on Growth and 1,200 on Enterprise, with short bursts of up to twice the
limit for 10 seconds. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429; wait for the Retry-After period before retrying.
Q. How long is an API token valid?
Access tokens are valid for 60 minutes. Request a new token with the client-credentials grant when it expires.
5. Security and Data
Q. Which certifications does Nexora hold?
SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001. A GDPR data-processing agreement is available on request.
Q. Can I choose where my data is stored?
Yes. When creating a workspace you select Mumbai, Frankfurt or Bahrain. Changing the region later requires a
migration handled by support.

Q. Is single sign-on available?
SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect SSO are available on the Enterprise plan only. Starter and Growth use email
and password with optional two-factor authentication.
6. Troubleshooting
Q. How do I reset my password?
Choose Forgot password on the login page. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes and can be used once. If the
email does not arrive, check the spam folder and confirm the address with your admin.

Q. Why is my API returning 429 errors?
Your client exceeded the plan's rate limit. Reduce request frequency, batch calls, and use exponential backoff.
Upgrade the plan if you need a higher limit.
Q. Where can I check service status?
The public status page at status.nexora.example lists current incidents and past uptime. Enterprise customers
also receive incident updates by email from the on-call team.
